annotations.title: Official PDF upload limits for a portal

description: Look up the official file size limit and accepted format for an upload portal or service (for example IRCC, USCIS, ImmiAccount, CM/ECF, Gmail, Turnitin, Etsy) with the official source and the date it was checked, plus a compressor page already set to a safe target size. Use this when a user says a portal rejected their file or asks how big a PDF may be.

portal.description: Portal, agency or service name, e.g. "IRCC" or "USCIS".
